description: Deadpan explainers of the internet's strangest standards, each one checked against the RFC it quotes.
name: Pigeon Post
tagline: The internet's strangest RFCs, explained straight.

videos.description: Wren asks and Otis, who has read the source, explains RFC 1149: the memo dated 1 April 1990 that specifies how to carry IP datagrams on avian carriers. They follow one datagram from a hexadecimal scroll taped to a pigeon's leg back into electronic form, played completely straight. Every factual line is checked against a pinned copy of the RFC, which calls itself an experimental, not recommended standard.
